mapper.sql: conversation_item.id, conversation_item.conversation_id, conversation_item.sequence_no, conversation_item.item_type, conversation_item.role, conversation_item.payload, conversation_item.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_item ( conversation_id, sequence_no, item_type, role, payload ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{itemType}, #{role}, #{payload} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM conversation_item INNER JOIN chat_conversation ON chat_conversation.id = conversation_item.conversation_id WHERE conversation_item.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND chat_conversation.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY conversation_item.sequence_no ASC
